title: Head of Data Collection Operations, Nimble Brain

fields.duties:
About Nimble
Nimble
is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you.
We are on a mission to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial. We will accomplish this by training robot AGI to invent and build the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by generalist superhumanoids.
Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including
Fei-Fei Li
(Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab),
Marc Raibert
(founder of Boston Dynamics), and
Sebastian Thrun
(founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles).
Let’s be legendary.

Why Join Nimble?
At Nimble, we are committed to building legendary products, a legendary team, and a legendary legacy. Join us and become part of an ambitious, humble, and resourceful culture where your work will leave a lasting impact on the future of robotics and commerce.
Nimble's Core Values:
Be relentlessly resourceful
-
Challenge conventions and overcome obstacles.
Be legendary
-
Be the very best and do work that inspires.
Be humble
-
Prioritize growth, learning, and doing whatever is needed to further the mission.
Be dependable
-
Take ownership and deliver with high agency.
Position Overview
Nimble's Brain is the data and model engine behind our supply chain super humanoid robots — the pipeline that turns raw operational data into the training sets, evaluations, and feedback loops that make our robots smarter every day. We're looking for a Head of Data Collection Operations on Nimble’s Brain team to own the day-to-day operational rigor of that pipeline: making sure data collection, labeling, quality review, and delivery run like clockwork at scale, across every site and every robot fleet.
In this role, you will manage the operational systems and teams responsible for sourcing, collecting, labeling, auditing, and delivering the data that trains Nimble's models. You'll build and refine the workflows, staffing plans, and quality checkpoints that keep data flowing accurately and on schedule, and you'll be the operational bridge between on-site data teams, labeling vendors/annotators, and the research and engineering teams who consume the data.
You'll work daily with site operations, supply chain, research, and engineering to forecast data needs, unblock throughput issues, and continuously raise the bar on data accuracy and completeness. This is a hands-on, metrics-driven role — success looks like clean, reliable, on-time data that directly improves the intelligence and safety of Nimble's robots.
Responsibilities
Own end-to-end data operations for Nimble's Brain: intake, collection, labeling, quality auditing, and delivery of training and evaluation datasets.
Design and run the operational processes and staffing plans (in-house and vendor/BPO) needed to label and QA data at scale, on schedule, and within budget.
Define and track operational metrics — throughput, accuracy, turnaround time, cost per label — and build the dashboards and reporting cadence to keep the org aligned.
Build feedback loops between data quality issues and upstream fixes, partnering with research and engineering to close the loop quickly.
Coordinate with on-site data collection teams across warehouse locations to ensure data capture protocols are followed consistently.
Manage relationships and SLAs with external labeling/annotation vendors, including onboarding, training, and performance management.
Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the data pipeline, escalating and driving cross-functional fixes where needed.
Continuously improve tooling, documentation, and standard operating procedures for data operations as Nimble scales.
Qualifications
4+ years in data operations, labeling operations, business/technical operations, or a similar role managing high-volume operational pipelines.
Track record building and running scalable operational processes, ideally involving data collection, annotation/labeling, or quality assurance.
Comfortable managing vendor/BPO relationships and driving performance against SLAs.
Strong metrics orientation — able to define KPIs, build reporting, and use data to drive operational decisions.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills; able to align research, engineering, and operations stakeholders.
Demonstrated ownership and comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Alignment with Nimble's values of being resourceful, humble, dependable, and committed to legendary impact.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in AI/ML data pipelines, data labeling platforms, or model evaluation workflows.
Background in robotics, autonomy, warehouse operations, or supply chain environments.
Experience standing up or scaling a data operations function from an earlier stage.
Compensation
The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be
between $150,000 and $250,000/year
. Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this position will also receive generous equity for this position.
Culture:
We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit!
Nimble Robotics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state, federal or local laws.
Nimble's Benefits
Unlimited Flexible Time Off
Enjoy the time you need to travel, rejuvenate, and connect with friends and family.
Health Insurance
Nimble provides medical, dental, and vision insurance through several premier plans and options to support you and your family.
Paid Parental Leave
Enjoy paid bonding time following a birth.
Commuter Benefits
Take the stress out of commuting with access to fully paid parking spots.
Referral Bonus
Get a cash bonus for any friend or colleagues that you refer to us that we end up hiring.
401k
Contribute towards a 401k for retirement planning.
Equity
Be an owner in Nimble through our equity program

title: 大数据开发工程师（湖仓一体）

fields.duties:
【工作职责】

1.负责具身智能数据基础设施架构建设

2.构建 PB-EB 级多模态数据基础设施，支撑视频、图片、日志、标签等数据统一管理；

3.建设面向端到端模型训练的数据供应链（Data Supply Chain），支撑数据生产、治理、交付及持续迭代；

4.建设元数据、Catalog、权限治理、数据质量、数据血缘等基础能力；

5.建设统一数据服务能力，支撑训练、分析、评测及业务系统的数据访问；

6.建设数据开发、数据分析、数据交付等平台工具，提高数据生产效率；

7.建设流批一体的数据采集、加工及数据生产能力；

8.建设端到端模型训练数据管理能力，提升训练数据质量与迭代效率。

9.能深入理解算法团队需求，将 AI 数据生产流程抽象为平台能力；

10.持续跟踪 AI Data Infrastructure、Lakehouse、Data Engineering 等前沿技术，推动新架构在智能驾驶场景落地。

【任职要求】

1.具备大型分布式系统架构设计及工程落地能力，能主导核心系统设计及关键代码开发；

2.熟悉 AI 数据生产流程，对模型训练数据管理、数据闭环、数据飞轮有深入理解；

3.熟悉至少一门主流工程语言：Python / Java / Go / C++；

4.熟悉大规模数据系统性能优化、高可用架构及稳定性建设；

5.熟悉 Spark、Flink、Trino 等计算引擎；

6.熟悉 Iceberg/Paimon/Hudi 等 Lakehouse 技术；

7.熟悉对象存储、元数据管理、Catalog、数据治理体系。

fields.duties:
Location: Irvine, CA
Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven(1) approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications.
About Field AI
Field AI is at the forefront of robotic embodied AI, transforming industries like construction, security, mining, and manufacturing. Our autonomous robots operate globally, often in harsh environments, delivering critical insights to customers. Whether monitoring construction progress, ensuring safety compliance, or conducting predictive maintenance, Field AI is advancing technology to make a meaningful impact.
Learn more at https://fieldai.com.
About the Data Platform Team
 Every robot we deploy generates a continuous stream of telemetry, sensor logs, and operational data from environments around the world. The Data Platform team builds the systems that capture every autonomy intervention, anomaly, and operational signal from globally deployed robots, classify them, and turn them into the ranked problem list that drives our engineering roadmap.
About the Job
As a Data Platform Engineer, Data Pipelines, you will design and build the systems and integrations that help move data reliably from robots in the field to the teams and services that depend on it — analytics, autonomy, ML training, and deployment operations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams spanning robotics, autonomy, and deployment to build the data backbone of a field robotics company.


What You'll Get To Do
Design and build the data platform, frameworks, and developer tooling that power ingestion across Field AI.
Handle the realities of field data: intermittent connectivity, large sensor payloads (LiDAR, camera, IMU), edge-to-cloud synchronization, and backfill from offline deployments.
Develop reusable ingestion SDKs, APIs, and services that enable teams to onboard new robotics data sources with minimal custom code.
Build and maintain integrations across heterogeneous sources: robot/edge systems, fleet management and deployment tooling, simulation outputs, and cloud object storage.
Integrate the platform with downstream consumers: BI tools, ML training and evaluation pipelines, labeling systems, and issue tracking.
Develop connectors and APIs (REST/gRPC, webhooks, CDC) so internal teams can feed data in and consume curated datasets reliably.
Own integration reliability end to end: schema contracts, versioning, retries, backfills, and monitoring.
Optimize pipeline performance, scalability, and cost across growing fleet deployments.

What You Have
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
3–5+ years of experience in
data engineering or backend engineering
focused on pipelines and infrastructure.
Strong programming skills in
Python and SQL
(C++, Scala, or Java a plus).
Production experience with
streaming systems (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
and orchestration tools such as
Airflow or Dagster
.
Experience with a modern
warehouse or lakehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift)
and cloud object storage at scale.
Experience building integrations across systems: third-party APIs, internal services, and
CDC/ELT tooling (Fivetran, Airbyte, Debezium, or custom connectors)
.
Experience building for data quality: testing, monitoring, lineage, and incident response.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in interdisciplinary teams.

The Extras That Set You Apart
Experience with
robotics, autonomy, automotive, or other telemetry-heavy operational data
(bag files, fleet logs, time-series sensor data).
Familiarity with robotics middleware and log formats such as
ROS/ROS2, MCAP, or rosbag
.
Experience with edge computing or intermittently connected data collection.
Experience with
dbt
or similar transformation frameworks.

Field AI Onsite Work Philosophy:
Field AI believes in-person collaboration is essential for tackling complex challenges. These are fully onsite roles based in our Irvine office, with flexible hours to support work-life balance.
We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world's most complex challenges: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ set a new standard in perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, ensuring our approach is explainable and safe for deployment. The data platform this team builds will carry every signal our robots produce — the raw material behind every autonomy improvement we ship.
You will have the opportunity to work with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. With a decade-long track record of deploying solutions in the field, winning DARPA challenge segments, and bringing expertise from organizations like DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise Self-Driving, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, we are set to achieve our ambitious goals.

Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution

To tackle such ambitious challenges, we need a team as unique as our vision — innovators who go beyond conventional methods and are eager to tackle tough, uncharted questions. We're seeking individuals who challenge the status quo, dive into uncharted territory, and bring interdisciplinary expertise. Our team requires not only top AI talent but also exceptional software developers, engineers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators.
Join us, shape the future, and be part of a fun, close-knit team on an exciting journey!
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

岗位职责
1. 端到云数据回传系统：构建从千台级机器人到云端的实时数据回传链路，解决跨地域、弱网环境下的高吞吐、低延迟传输问题，确保数据完整性与时序一致性。
2. 云端数据存储与管理：设计并实现 PB 级规模的数据存储系统，支持高并发写入与高效读取，满足训练侧对数据吞吐量的极致需求。
3. 分布式数据流水线：构建从数据采集、传输、存储到训练消费的端到端流水线，实现数据的高效流转，消除训练过程中的 I/O 瓶颈。
4. 系统可靠性与可观测性：建设分布式系统的容错机制、故障恢复能力与全链路可观测体系，确保千台规模下系统的稳定运行。

任职要求
1. 扎实的软件工程基础：精通 Python，具备 C++/Rust 等系统编程语言经验；有良好的代码设计能力与工程实践习惯。
2. 分布式系统原理：深入理解分布式系统的核心概念（CAP、一致性模型、容错机制），能够设计和实现可扩展、高可用的分布式架构。
3. 计算机网络：熟悉 TCP/IP 协议栈，理解网络传输的性能优化原理；有弱网环境下的系统设计经验者优先。
4. 分布式中间件：熟悉主流消息队列（Kafka/RabbitMQ）、对象存储（S3）、数据库等中间件的原理与使用，具备生产环境下的调优经验。

加分项：
有大规模分布式存储或流处理系统的开发经验
有千台级设备规模的数据管道设计与运维经验
主导或参与过具有影响力的分布式系统开源项目
在分布式系统领域发表过研究成果

title: 具身智能数据算法工程师

fields.duties:
参与构建具身智能数据闭环，从数据采集、自动标注、仿真生成到挖掘增强，全方位支撑模型训练与迭代。具体工作包括但不限于：

1、自动标注与操作数据处理：开发操作数据的自动标注算法（关键点检测、动作切片、抓取轨迹提取等），构建预标注pipeline与人机协同标注流程，建立质量评估体系，持续提升标注效率与覆盖率。

2、仿真数据生成：搭建仿真环境，开发多样化场景数据生成pipeline，研究Sim-to-Real迁移算法与Diffusion Model合成数据方案，建立域差异量化评估体系。

3、数据挖掘与增强：研发数据挖掘算法自动发现高价值片段与长尾case，设计主动学习策略指导采集优先级，基于生成模型（SD/ControlNet等）开发数据增强方案，解决少样本场景数据不足问题。

4、前沿探索：跟踪顶会与生成式AI前沿，定期技术调研与原型验证。。

【任职要求】

1、硕士及以上学历（仿真方向可放宽至本科），计算机视觉、人工智能、机器人学、仿真建模等相关专业。

2、精通Python和PyTorch，有扎实的深度学习工程化能力；

3、算法基础（满足其一即可，多方向优先）：

熟悉目标检测、语义分割、姿态估计；了解人体动作识别、时序动作检测、手部姿态估计。
仿真方向：熟悉Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab或Unity/Unreal等仿真平台；了解3D场景建模、材质、光照渲染基础及Sim-to-Real Gap相关技术。
数据挖掘/增强方向：具备异常检测/聚类/主动学习或Diffusion Model/GAN/生成模型的扎实能力。
具备独立阅读英文论文并复现的能力；有实际项目落地经验，良好的工程化与团队协作意识。

【加分项】

有CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/NeurIPS/ICLR等顶会论文发表
有机器人操作/遥操作数据、仿真数据生成或合成数据项目经验
有3D重建（NeRF/Gaussian Splatting）或Diffusion Model/视频生成模型经验
有AIGC/生成式AI公司实习经验或开源项目贡献经历

title: 数据引擎工程师（具身智能）

fields.duties:
岗位定位

负责具身智能数据平台的数据引擎建设，面向大规模多模态数据场景，构建数据接入、湖仓存储、分布式处理、混合检索和数据治理能力，为平台服务、算法训练、评测分析和 MLOps 链路提供稳定、高效的数据底座。




岗位职责

1、负责具身智能数据引擎建设，支撑多来源、多模态、大规模数据的统一接入、处理、检索和服务化输出。

2、建设 PB 级多模态数据湖仓能力，提升数据分层组织、统一管理、高效访问和存储成本优化能力。

3、建设大规模分布式批处理与调度引擎，支撑数据加工、质量检测、索引构建、数据集生成等核心链路的稳定运行。

4、建设多维度混合检索能力，支持结构化、向量、时空轨迹等多类检索场景，提升数据发现和召回效率。

5、建设数据标准、元数据、血缘和质量检测能力，提升数据规范化、可追溯性和可治理能力。

6、面向平台服务、算法训练、评测分析和 MLOps 链路，提供稳定的数据访问、处理、检索和数据集生成能力。




岗位要求

1、计算机、软件工程等相关专业硕士及以上学历，3年以上数据平台、数据开发、Data Infra相关经验。

2、精通数据接入、湖仓架构、分布式处理、数据建模、元数据、血缘、质量和生命周期管理等数据系统核心能力。

3、精通 Python、C++、Java 中至少一种语言，熟练使用SQL，熟悉Linux、对象存储、分布式文件系统、批处理/流处理、任务调度、数据校验等基础技术。

4、具备数据处理性能优化、存储优化或检索系统相关经验，能够处理真实场景中的数据规模、性能瓶颈、格式差异和链路稳定性问题。

5、加分项：有自动驾驶/具身智能数据闭环经验；熟悉具身或自驾相关数据格式，如 ROS/ROS2、rosbag/MCAP、HDF5、Parquet/Arrow 等；有湖仓架构、多模态数据处理、传感器数据处理、数据集生产相关经验。

title: 数据平台工程师（具身智能）

fields.duties:
岗位定位负责具身智能数据平台建设，围绕数据生产、标注协作、问题分析、评测分析和数据闭环，沉淀面向算法、数据产线和具身软件团队的通用平台能力。




岗位职责

1、参与数据平台服务层的架构设计与核心能力建设，抽象数据资产、数据集、任务、流程、Case、评测等平台对象，形成稳定、可扩展的平台服务能力。

2、负责标注平台能力建设，支持多模态数据标注、任务分发、质检审核、进度追踪和结果管理，提升数据生产效率与质量。

3、建设问题分析与评测闭环能力，支持 badcase 管理、评测结果沉淀、指标分析、样本关联、归因定位和数据回流，推动数据、模型和系统持续迭代。

4、建设面向具身智能多模态数据的可视化与交互能力，提升图像、视频、点云、轨迹、状态等复杂数据的浏览、分析、标注和复盘效率。

5、建设面向算法、数据产线和上下游系统的 Open API、SDK/CLI 与集成能力，支持数据访问、任务流转、状态同步、结果上报和数据回流。

6、建设平台服务稳定性与可观测性能力，覆盖服务监控、任务链路追踪、接口调用分析、异常告警、操作审计、日志分析和故障定位，保障平台服务的稳定运行和问题可追溯。




岗位要求

1、计算机、软件工程等相关专业硕士及以上学历，3年以上 AI平台、数据平台、标注平台或工程工具类产品开发经验。

2、具备较强的平台服务设计与工程交付能力，能够围绕数据资产、任务流程、权限治理、版本管理、审计追踪等能力进行系统抽象和平台化建设。

3、精通 Python、Go、Java、TypeScript 中至少一种语言，熟悉前后端开发范式、数据库、对象存储、缓存等技术。

4、具备良好的产品意识、工程素养和跨团队协作能力，能够理解算法、数据产线及上下游系统的使用诉求，并推动平台能力落地。

5、加分项：有标注平台、自动驾驶/具身智能/大模型数据闭环平台、多模态数据处理、点云/视频/轨迹可视化相关经验者优先。

title: 机器人全栈工程师（初/中/高级）

fields.duties:
本岗位聚焦机器人数采全链路、模型训练准备及技术创新，寻找热爱机器人行业的机器人全栈工程师（覆盖初/中/高各级能力），负责各类数据采集和处理链路搭建、数据治理及模型训练前期准备工作，与行业顶尖团队并肩，共同加速具身智能落地干活。

* 利用扎实的机器人系统、控制、感知等全栈知识，搭建并优化机器人数据采集链路，负责机器人真机数采与无本体数采方案设计与落地，保障各类采集数据的完整性、准确性、有效性。

* 负责数据清洗、标注、格式转换及数据集构建，完成模型训练前期数据准备工作，配合算法团队优化数据质量。

* 基于机器人操作系统完成相关开发、仿真调试，配合完成真机数采、无本体数采相关的整机联调、故障排查，沉淀技术文档与标准化流程（高级岗需主导链路架构设计）。

* 探索数据采集、模型训练相关前沿技术，提升数据采集效率与数据质量，高级岗需主导技术决策与疑难问题攻坚。




任职要求

* 硕士及以上学历，计算机、自动化、电子信息等相关专业，2年以上机器人全栈经验（应届生优秀者可面议），要求精通本领域技术且熟悉上下游领域知识。

* 技术能力：熟悉基础通信及工业总线，能完成真机数采、无本体数采链路的数据协议设计实现与故障排查（高级岗需精通数采链路架构设计与复杂故障攻坚）。掌握C/C++、Python，熟悉机器人操作系统、Linux基础，具备机器人全栈知识，掌握数据采集、数据治理及模型训练基础，能完成对应职位层级的数据采集与模型准备相关开发调试（高级岗需具备架构设计和技术管理能力）。

* 动手能力强，不设边界，善于解决问题，具备团队协作意识，对机器人数据采集、模型训练有浓厚兴趣，愿意长期深耕。

* 有机器人数据采集、数据集构建相关经验者优先；熟悉或有模型训练经验者优先；在主流机器人大赛中获得过奖项或在重要会议上发表过论文者优先；精通机器人感知、规控、系统软件其中一项者优先。




我们能提供

* 清晰的初/中/高晋升路径，极致的迭代速度与团队气氛，行业顶尖团队，完善的技术培训与成长支持。

* 极具竞争力的薪酬（按能力层级匹配）。

设计并实现 Session、Episode、Event、Annotation 等核心数据模型，保证标注结果具备版本管理、数据血缘和可复现能力；

使用 Go 开发任务分发、并发编辑、权限管理、审核流转、审计和数据发布服务；
建设从原始 MCAP 到派生资产、Episode、标注结果、质量评估和训练数据集的 Pipeline，保证任务可重试、结果可追踪、过程可审计；
集成视觉模型、VLM 和时序模型，为标注平台提供预标注、事件检测、关键帧抽取和主动采样能力；
与算法、机器人和数据运营团队协作，将新的标注规范快速转化为可执行的标注任务和数据 Schema；

title: 机器人数据质量工程师

fields.duties:
岗位职责： 

 - 负责机器人多模态数据全生命周期质量管控，覆盖采集、质检、标注、清洗、入库、复用全链路，确保数据符合准确性、完整性、一致性、时效性、规范性要求，对数据交付质量负责。  

- 制定数据采集、标注、质检规范，建立数据缺陷处理流程，实现数据质量可追溯、可审计。 

 - 开发自动化质检工具，提升质检效率与数据质量，和模型团队共同定义机器人专用数据质量指标并开展数据治理和评估优化。  

- 运用FMEA、SPC等质量方法论，开展数据质量风险分析与根因分析，通过PDCA循环持续改进质量体系。  

- 对接跨团队数据需求，支撑机器人模型训练与迭代，跟踪行业新技术新标准优化管控方案。




岗位要求：

一、专业知识与领域认知

  - 本科及以上学历，计算机、自动化、机器人工程等相关专业，1-3年机器人/AI领域数据质量相关工作经验。

  - 熟悉机器人多模态传感器数据特性，熟悉真机遥操、UMI、Ego等数采方案的质量维护要点，熟悉rosbag/mcap等数据格式，了解具身智能数据逻辑者优先。

  - 掌握GB/T 36344-2018，熟悉ISO/IEC 5259系列标准，了解FMEA、SPC、PDCA等质量方法论。

  - 具备优秀质量风险意识和严谨性，能从模型Bad Case反推数据缺陷并定位根因。

  - 具备良好的跨团队沟通协作能力和快速学习能力，有相关项目经验者优先。

二、技术能力

  - 熟练Python，熟练使用SQL、Shell，能独立开发自动化质检脚本与数据处理工具；了解C++、熟悉机器人常用传感器者优先。

  - 掌握至少1种标注工具，熟悉数据可视化工具，了解时序数据库、对象存储等方案或有相关使用经验。

  - 理解大模型对数据的需求，能从算法反向定义数据标准，熟悉PyTorch者优先。
